description: Preservation program registry. One entry per owned Steam title. Adding a game means adding an entry here and a profile under games/<id>/; no tool change is required.
statusVocabularyNote: NOT APPLICABLE is the one addition to the mission's status list: it is used for the LAN/P2P capability of a title that has no multiplayer at all, so 'NOT INVESTIGATED' would imply missing work that does not exist.

resolutionOrder: libraryfolders.vdf next to the Steam client

games.title: Command & Conquer: Generals
games.notes: Executable carries a Steam DRM .bind section, so static string analysis cannot see the game's online code; runtime observation is required. Native LAN mode is advertised by the game but has not been measured here.

games.title: Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour
games.notes: Same wrapper situation as Generals: .bind-protected executable. Treated as its own build, not interchangeable with Generals.

games.title: Command & Conquer: Renegade
games.notes: First implementation target. Ships RenegadeFDS with a documented GameType = LAN mode, so local multiplayer needs no publisher infrastructure. The campaign's online paths (GameSpy master, Westwood mangler) are only reached from the online menus.

games.title: Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars
games.notes: Online stack is GameSpy SDK plus EA FESL; the launcher additionally contacts servserv.generals.ea.com. Offline campaign does not require those paths, which still needs a measured run to claim.

games.title: Command & Conquer 3: Kane's Wrath
games.notes: Own executable (CNC3EP1.exe + RetailExe/1.3/cnc3ep1.dat) with its own GameSpy product ids. Not interchangeable with Tiberium Wars.

games.title: Command & Conquer 4: Tiberian Twilight
games.notes: Launcher is a .NET assembly that talks to EA Blaze (launcher.support.blaze.com, rts.eala.ea.com). Progression and account state are server-side and no community replacement for Blaze exists, so offline preservation is blocked rather than merely unmeasured.

games.title: Friday the 13th: The Game
games.notes: Official online service ended 2024-12-31 and no dedicated server was ever shipped, so multiplayer preservation depends on a backend that does not legally exist. Offline bots, single-player challenges and the virtual cabin are the preserved surface.

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies: Game of the Year
games.notes: Highest-feasibility offline target: the only endpoint strings are PopCap registration/news URLs reached from an optional button, not from startup or gameplay.

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted
games.notes: Independent architecture from the 2009 game: Unity IL2CPP, GameAssembly.dll + il2cpp_data, its own save format. No endpoints in the launcher; the managed game code is inside GameAssembly.dll, which static string analysis has not covered yet.

games.title: SimCity 3000 Unlimited
games.notes: Steam copy is a GOG-packaged build (2022 executable, goggame-*.dll present). Only endpoint is the retired simcity.com exchange/chat service, reached from the in-game browser.

games.title: SimCity 4 Deluxe
games.notes: No service dependency: the executable references only maxis.com as text. Executable carries a Steam .bind section, so its strings are not fully readable statically.

games.title: Need for Speed: Rivals
games.notes: EA's Rivals online services were switched off on 2025-10-07. Solo AllDrive exists, but both executables load Core/Activation*.dll and reference GOS redirectors, so whether an offline launch succeeds is unmeasured.

games.title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3
games.notes: Manifest StateFlags 1026 with 463 MB of 7.15 GB downloaded and no files on disk: a partial download, not an installation. Nothing can be inspected until the user finishes installing it.

games.title: Command & Conquer Remastered Collection
games.notes: Manifest reports build 0 and size 0 with an empty install directory: the app is owned but not installed.
